note: The main banks: the Windward Islands Bank (WIB, of the Maduro & Curiel's group), RBC Royal Bank and CIBC Caribbean, Sint Maarten's largest retail banks. RBC Royal Bank's Sint Maarten credit cards page (rendered 30 October 2026): its personal RBC Rewards Visa Platinum, Visa Gold and Visa Classic International, in US dollars, each with its annual fee and its 18% purchase and cash advance rates; its business cards aren't written, and the page states no other fee. The Windward Islands Bank's bankcard services fees page (read 30 October 2026) gives its cards' annual membership fees (Visa and Mastercard Classic USD 36.75, Visa Advantage USD 63.00, Visa Platinum USD 141.75, Kompa Leon XCG 63.00) but no interest rate, and its credit cards page none either, so its cards aren't written. CIBC Caribbean's schedule for Sint Maarten isn't among those its site serves. This file kept RBC's Visa Classic International, read on 29 October 2026. Wave 4 (30 October 2026) looked for more banks and added none: the Windward Islands Bank's bankcard services fees give its cards' annual memberships (Visa and Mastercard Classic USD 36.75, Advantage USD 63.00, Platinum USD 141.75, Kompa Leon XCG 63.00) but none of its pages states an interest rate, so its cards can't be written; CIBC Caribbean's schedules for Sint Maarten aren't among those its site serves.
